submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when the text resolves a publicly contested selection between sides: an election or nomination to a post (elected/nominated a new leader/candidate), a trial verdict (pleaded/found not guilty), a match outcome (scored the winning/losing goal), or royal succession (in a kingdom ... lived a young princess), peaking on the word that fixes the outcome (not, winning/losing, scored, a, next). The same trigger tokens stay near the ~0.2 baseline outside contest framing (is not red, invited a friend, hired a leader, kicked/saw the ball).

adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel election resolution in a news register with the winning trigger in outcome-fixing position.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The conclave elected a new pope on the fourth ballot yesterday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel nomination to a post in a religious register, testing generalization beyond elections and trials.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The jury acquitted the defendant of all charges after deliberation.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase holdout expressing a trial verdict without any claimed trigger token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The striker netted the decisive goal in stoppage time.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase holdout expressing a match outcome without scored, winning or losing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Parliament confirmed the crown passes to the next heir following the abdication.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Cross-genre royal succession holdout in a formal news register rather than a fairy tale.
